title: Essential surjectivity of the derived functor to a Serre quotient
author: The Stacks Project Authors
difficulty_reason: The proof strictifies a complex in the quotient category in both directions: pushouts handle nonnegative degrees and pullbacks handle negative degrees. It must then replace terms by finite sums of images and intersections of kernels so the lifted differentials square to zero in the original category. This is an actual lifting construction for unbounded quotient complexes.
